abstract: The National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) provides three principal resources containing DNA, RNA, and protein sequence data: the Sequence Read Archive (SRA), GenBank®, and the Reference Sequence (RefSeq™) collection. All resources are free to the public. SRA and GenBank are part of the International Nucleotide Sequence Database Collaboration and share data daily. After summarizing the current state of these resources, we review significant updates in the past two years, including these to the Submission Portal, the primary interface for submitting data to SRA and GenBank. We also describe access points for these data including NCBI Datasets' website and programmatic interface, and present improvements in NCBI's main sequence analysis and visualization tools, such as annotation pipelines, BLAST, and the Multiple Comparative Genome Viewer.
